SymptomReport.title: SymptomReport
SymptomReport.description: Anonymized lab report symptom and location report for epidemiological surveillance

symptom.description: Short extracted symptom keyword or medical finding

category.description: Clinical category such as Hematology, Metabolic, Infection, etc.

lat.description: Approximate latitude coordinate of pincode centroid

lng.description: Approximate longitude coordinate of pincode centroid

regionName.description: City or regional locality name associated with the pincode

confidenceScore.description: AI extraction confidence score from 0 to 1

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp string representing when the report was analyzed

/symptom_reports/{reportId}.description: Collection of anonymized symptom reports for public health dashboard mapping
